title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - VMImage
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/VMImage. Image for virtual machines. Subclass of Image per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the Image model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'VMImage'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

vmImageDiskFormat.description: Property. Disk format of the VM image. Default 'RAW'. Controlled-vocabulary value (VMDiskType), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

hypervisorType.description: Property. Hypervisor type required by the image. Controlled-vocabulary value (HypervisorType), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

firmwareType.description: Property. Type of firmware with which guests are booted. Controlled-vocabulary value (FirmType), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

hwRngTypeOfImage.description: Property. Type of physical phenomena the hardware random number generator (RNG) this image prefers is based on. Controlled-vocabulary value (RNGTypes), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

watchDogAction.description: Property. The action to be performed if the server hangs. Controlled-vocabulary value (WatchDogActions), enumeration not resolved in this pass.
